question: Which among the following is a traditional Hindu festival centered on the Goddess Mahakali from Telangana, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bonalu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bonalu **is a **traditional Hindu festival **celebrated in the **Telangana region** of India, especially in the** twin cities **of **Hyderabad and Secunderabad.**
 
• The festival is celebrated in the month of** Ashada (July-August)** and is dedicated to** Goddess Mahakali,** who is believed to protect the people from diseases and **other calamities.**
 
• The festival involves the worship of **decorated pots or bonalu, **which are offered to the goddess with offerings of **rice, jaggery, curd, and other items.**
 
• The festival is also marked by **colorful processions, music, and dance** performances by women, who carry the bonalu pots on their heads and dance to the beats of drums and other instruments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dehing Patkai **is a** national park and wildlife sanctuary** located in the northeastern state of Assam, India.

 
 
• It is known for its **rich biodiversity **and is home to several rare and endangered species of flora and fauna.
 
 
 
• **Ugadi **is a traditional New Year's Day festival celebrated in the** southern states of India,** especially **Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Karnataka**.
 
 
• It marks the beginning of a new year as per the** Hindu calendar.**
 
 
 
• **Lohri **is a harvest festival celebrated in the northern states of India, especially **Punjab, Haryana, and Himachal Pradesh.**
 
 
• It is marked by **bonfires, music, and dance performances**, and the distribution of sweets and other food items
